name: Pro Data Lineage Graph
description: Upstream/downstream data lineage DAG for dbt and data-catalog products: lazy N-level expansion through react-query, column-level lineage tracing, status badges, focus mode, dataset search, minimap and a layered dagre layout that stays smooth at 2k+ nodes.

props.name: rootId
props.description: Dataset the graph centres on; changing it resets the graph

props.name: fetchLineage
props.description: Loads `depth` levels upstream or downstream of a dataset; results are cached by react-query

props.name: initialDepth
props.description: Levels loaded in both directions on mount (default 1)

props.name: defaultExpandDepth
props.description: Levels loaded per expand click; changeable from the toolbar (default 1)

props.name: focusId / onFocusChange
props.description: Controlled focus mode: dims everything outside the dataset's full upstream + downstream

props.name: queryClient
props.description: Share the app's react-query cache; a private client is created otherwise

props.name: staleTime
props.description: Cache lifetime of expand results in ms (default 5 minutes)

props.name: showMiniMap / showDetails
props.description: Toggle the minimap and the selected-dataset panel (default true)

usage: Pass a fetcher returning { nodes, edges } for a dataset's neighbourhood. Set hasUpstream / hasDownstream on datasets that can be expanded further, and add columns plus edge column links for column-level lineage. Keyboard: Tab to a dataset, F focus mode, [ / ] expand upstream / downstream, C toggle columns, Escape clears.
